Creative Flavors and a Great Dining Experience
Aug 2026 • Solo
Chutoro Toast — The chutoro tasted fresh and clean, and I loved how generous they were with the fish. Everything was well-balanced, and the bottarga complemented the other ingredients without overpowering them. The bread had a nice crispy exterior, although I wish the inside had been a little softer and fluffier.

Peking Duck Croquettes — The croquettes had a cispy exterior, but I wish the richness and flavor of the duck had come through a little more.

Hamachi Crudo — The sauce was creamy and packed with umami, while the hamachi itself was rich and flavorful. Some pieces had slightly tough connective tissue that didn’t separate easily. Flavor-wise, though, this was very well-balanced. The chili, acidity, and sweetness all worked together without any one element overpowering the others. Overall, everything felt cohesive.

Lamb Gnocchi Sugo — The gnocchi was tender and pillowy, and the lamb was just as tender. The sugo was rich, savory, and full of flavor. This was delicious overall, though I would have loved a little more Manchego.

The service was great, and I really enjoyed the atmosphere as well.

Delicate, fine dishes with bags of flavour!
May 2026 • Friends
Right off the top, every dish was exceptional! Do yourself a favour and add this small Michelin rated 4year old restaurant to your list of places to eat. Lamb skewers juicy and tender, Hokkaido scallop sliced in half with xo dressing, duck croquettes were delicate and super tasty. Oh and fried potato cakes like no other. For mains we shared 2 pasta dishes - Lamb gnocchi sugo and Prawn Malfadine (long ribbon pasta). Grilled Barramundi, Half chicken with garlic sambal and the very moorish Nduja xo crab fried rice. Desserts were Sticky Toffee Date and Watermelon Granita - both completed a very delicious dining experience. Four deliriously happy diners 🌟🌟🌟🌟

Elgin Marbelous
Jan 2026 • Couples
Found this restaurant in the Michelin guide and thought we’d give it a go - we weren’t disappointed.
A very modern feel greeted us and a reassuring short menu.
The staff were great and very professional whilst at the same time very friendly and welcoming.
The food was fabulous. We started with yellow tail tuna cervicé and an interesting take on ‘hash brown’. For main we had an amazing lamb ragu gnocchi and Brussel sprout & belly pork dish - both superb. We shared a watermelon granita dessert washed down with a complimentary kalhua coffee shot (?)
Great time here albeit slightly more expensive at VND2.5m (inc 4 wines, vat and 5% service charge).

Fun and casual place with fine dining food options... without the white tablecloths.
Aug 2025 • Couples
If you're looking for somewhere quiet and intimate, this probably isn't your spot. However, if you're looking for fine dining caliber food sans the white tables cloth, in a casual, trendy environment where people are enjoying themselves, then this is your place. Our friends tried the 8-course tasting menu, while my wife and I opted for ala carte dishes, as I had my eye on the short rib dish while checking over the menu when booking our table. My wife enjoyed the pork belly. All four us enjoyed the experience. I was pleasantly surprised by some of the wine options; not your usual suspects on the list. The service staff was incredibly attentive and the noisy, but friendly ambiance added to the experience. As some table was celebrating a birthday, the entire dining area erupted in an improv rendition of "Happy Birthday". We will definitely be back to enjoy another great meal here!

One of the Best Meals We’ve Had In A Long Time!
Feb 2025 • Couples
We had an absolutely fantastic dining experience at Elgin in Ho Chi Minh City! From the moment we walked in, the atmosphere was chic and inviting, setting the perfect tone for an amazing meal.

One of the things we loved most was their shared plates style—it allowed us to try a variety of incredible dishes, and every single one was outstanding. We had the chutoro toast, chicken ayam taliwang, lamb gnocchi, tropical granita, and sticky toffee pudding. Everything was so good that we couldn’t even pick a favorite!

A special shout-out to Doug, who went above and beyond to make our night extra special. His friendly service made us feel truly welcomed, and to top it off, he even surprised us with a free dessert! It’s rare to find such great hospitality these days, and Doug absolutely nailed it.

Five stars all around! If you’re in Saigon, love food, and are looking for a top-notch dining experience, Elgin is the place to go.
